basic.text:
Saturday bakery notes

Notes from the Saturday shift. Written for the person who opens on Sunday.

The bread

The dough went in at six. Keep the oven at 220 degrees and bake the white loaves for 28 minutes. The crust should be deep brown before they come out.

The rye loaves need ten more minutes than the white ones. Leave them on the rack by the window so the crust stays crisp.

The till

The card machine settles overnight.

Count the float to fifty pounds before the first customer, and put the notes in the blue tin under the counter.

Before you leave

Close the shop before you go home. Turn both ovens off, wipe the steel counters, lock the shop door, set the alarm with the code on the hook, and leave the cash drawer open and empty.

The council tax for the flat upstairs is due on Monday. Pay it from the personal account, not the bakery till.
